name: print-social-notebook-testimonial-on-red-with-denim-stars
title: Testimonial on a spiral notebook page with denim star patches on brick red
whatItIs: A 4:5 post on grainy brick red. A white spiral-bound notepad page holds a script name and title, a taped instant photo of a 3D character, and a paragraph with one phrase highlighted in pale yellow. Two blue stitched denim star patches and a handle sit at the edges.
whatItMeans: Personal, tactile and trustworthy; the notebook feels like a real diary entry from a student.
techniques: Use a realistic stationery object (notepad) as the content container.
Tape a small photo or avatar to the page with a translucent strip.
Highlight a key phrase with a marker-like yellow swipe.
Add stitched patch stickers for texture.
bestFor: Any post needing an authentic diary feel

vocabulary.definition: A physical item used as the frame for text.
A translucent yellow swipe behind words.
A translucent strip attaching an image.
